fields.Name: T208 - System Diagnostics Cache Stats and Type Filter
fields.Description: Exercises the LocalCacheManager stats surface (hit-rate computation, by-type breakdown) plus the cache-type filter (setCacheTypeFilter narrowing filteredCacheEntries) — a client-cache-specific feature, not a generic grid filter.

InputDefinition.goal: You are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to the Admin application, open 'Monitoring', select System Diagnostics, then click the 'Cache' section tab. Confirm the Local Cache summary cards render (Total Entries, Total Size, Cache Hits, Cache Misses, Hit Rate). If cache entries are present, use the entry-list filter buttons (All / Datasets / RunViews / RunQueries) and confirm the entries table responds — clicking a type narrows the list to that type (or shows nothing when that type is empty), and clicking 'All' restores it. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing the cache summary cards render and the type filter respond (or a valid cache-not-initialized / empty state) is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Cache section shows summary cards including Total Entries, Total Size, Hits, Misses, and Hit Rate (or a valid 'Cache not initialized' warning)
When cache entries exist, clicking a type filter (Datasets / RunViews / RunQueries / All) changes which entries are listed accordingly
The Hit Rate value is displayed as a percentage
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
